short-description: Build, schedule, and grow your rail network to fulfill transportation demands. Optimize paths around forests, mountains and rivers, and balance fuel costs. Across real-world continents or on endlessly unique maps, build the best railway company, one train at a time!
marketing-oneliner: Cargo, Commuters, and Chaos! Lay tracks, schedule trains, and optimize routes to transport passengers and cargo across the map.
